leaves.leaf: Julia project history, release timeline and community
leaves.scope: Julia's origins at MIT, its founders, the 2012 announcement, version release dates and LTS designations from 0.x to 1.12, JuliaCon, Julia Computing/JuliaHub, NumFOCUS sponsorship and awards.
queries: Julia programming language history Bezanson Karpinski Shah Edelman
Julia Computing JuliaHub funding Wilkinson Prize

leaves.leaf: Type system: abstract, parametric and Union types
leaves.scope: Julia's nominative type lattice: abstract and concrete types, parametric types, invariance, UnionAll and where clauses, Union and small-union optimization, singleton and Type{T} types, and type intersection and join.
queries: abstract type subtyping UnionAll where clause
Union types Nothing Missing small union optimization

leaves.leaf: Composite types, mutability and constructors
leaves.scope: struct and mutable struct definitions, inner and outer constructors, new() and incomplete initialization, const fields in mutable structs, Base.@kwdef, isbits layout and field introspection.
queries: inner constructor outer constructor new incomplete initialization
Base.@kwdef keyword constructor default field values
isbitstype immutable struct memory layout fieldtypes

leaves.leaf: Multiple dispatch, method tables and world age
leaves.scope: How Julia chooses methods: specificity rules, ambiguity errors, invoke, Vararg and type-parameter dispatch, method redefinition, method tables and the world-age mechanism.
queries: dispatch on type parameters Vararg methods

leaves.leaf: Function syntax, operators and variable scoping rules
leaves.scope: Function definition forms, keyword and optional arguments, varargs and splatting, do-blocks, closures and anonymous functions, operator precedence, Unicode operator input, and global/local and soft/hard scope rules.
queries: keyword arguments varargs splatting optional arguments
do block syntax anonymous function closures
soft scope hard scope global local Julia 1.5
operator precedence Unicode operators LaTeX tab completion

leaves.leaf: Metaprogramming: expressions, macros and generated functions
leaves.scope: Expr objects, quoting and interpolation, Symbol and QuoteNode, macro hygiene and esc, Meta.parse and eval, @generated functions, and non-standard string literals.
queries: macro hygiene esc Expr quote interpolation
Meta.parse eval QuoteNode Symbol head args

leaves.leaf: Arrays, indexing and broadcasting
leaves.scope: Array and the AbstractArray interface, IndexStyle, linear and Cartesian indexing, views and SubArray, the Memory-backed Array implementation, and broadcasting with dot fusion and BroadcastStyle.
queries: broadcasting dot syntax fusion BroadcastStyle Broadcasted

leaves.leaf: Collections, dictionaries and the iteration protocol
leaves.scope: The iterate protocol and its traits, Dict, Set, IdDict and WeakKeyDict hashing semantics, the Iterators module, comprehensions, generators, and reduction functions.
queries: Iterators module zip product partition flatten

leaves.leaf: Numeric types, promotion and arithmetic semantics
leaves.scope: Integer and floating-point types, overflow behavior, checked arithmetic, promotion and conversion rules, BigInt and BigFloat via GMP and MPFR, Rational, Complex, Irrational, Float16 and rounding modes.
queries: integer overflow wraparound Int64 UInt8 checked arithmetic
BigInt BigFloat GMP MPFR precision setprecision
Rational Complex Irrational Float16 rounding modes

leaves.leaf: Strings, characters, Unicode and regular expressions
leaves.scope: UTF-8 String representation, code units versus Char code points, string indexing pitfalls, SubString, interpolation and raw/triple-quoted literals, and PCRE2-based Regex matching.
queries: String UTF-8 codeunits Char codepoint indexing
regular expressions PCRE2 Regex match eachmatch
string interpolation raw strings triple-quoted escapes

leaves.leaf: Modules, namespaces and code loading
leaves.scope: module, using and import semantics, export and the public keyword, baremodule, Core and Base, include, __init__, relative module paths and how Julia locates and loads code.
queries: code loading LOAD_PATH relative module paths

leaves.leaf: Exceptions, stack traces and logging
leaves.scope: try/catch/finally, throw and rethrow, the built-in exception hierarchy, backtraces and StackFrame, and the Logging standard library with log levels, loggers and logging macros.
queries: try catch finally throw rethrow exception
ArgumentError BoundsError MethodError DomainError exception types

leaves.leaf: Pkg package manager, environments and registries
leaves.scope: Project.toml and Manifest.toml, compat and semver rules, Pkg REPL commands, environment stacks, package extensions and weak dependencies, workspaces, the General registry, Registrator, TagBot and package servers.
queries: Pkg REPL add develop pin free
General registry Registrator TagBot pkg server

leaves.leaf: C/Fortran interop and binary dependencies
leaves.scope: ccall and @ccall, cfunction callbacks, Ptr and Ref, C type mappings, GC.@preserve and unsafe operations, Libdl, and binary dependency delivery through BinaryBuilder, Yggdrasil, JLL packages and Artifacts.
queries: Artifacts.toml artifact lazy download Libdl dlopen

leaves.leaf: Interoperability with Python, R, C++ and other languages
leaves.scope: Packages that connect Julia with other languages, including PyCall, PythonCall/juliacall, RCall, CxxWrap, JavaCall and MATLAB.jl, covering their conversion rules and configuration.

leaves.leaf: Multithreading, tasks and asynchronous programming
leaves.scope: Tasks and Channels, @async and the libuv event loop, Threads.@threads and @spawn, the scheduler and thread pools, thread-count settings, atomics, locks and ScopedValues.

leaves.leaf: Distributed and cluster computing
leaves.scope: The Distributed standard library (addprocs, remotecall, pmap, @distributed, futures), cluster managers for schedulers, SharedArrays, DistributedArrays, MPI.jl and Dagger.jl.

leaves.leaf: GPU programming
leaves.scope: Julia's GPU stack: CUDA.jl, AMDGPU.jl, Metal.jl and oneAPI.jl, kernel programming, GPUArrays semantics such as scalar indexing, and portable kernels with KernelAbstractions.

leaves.leaf: Compiler internals: lowering, type inference and IR
leaves.scope: The compilation pipeline from parsing (JuliaSyntax) and lowering to CodeInfo, SSA IR and IRCode, abstract-interpretation type inference in Core.Compiler, effects analysis, inlining and opaque closures.
queries: lowered code CodeInfo SSA IR IRCode
JuliaSyntax parser opaque closures inlining cost

leaves.leaf: LLVM code generation and SIMD optimization
leaves.scope: How Julia emits LLVM IR and native code, the introspection macros, LLVM version upgrades across releases, and vectorization tools including @simd, @inbounds, @fastmath, LoopVectorization and SIMD.jl.

leaves.leaf: Precompilation, latency and static compilation
leaves.scope: Time-to-first-execution issues and fixes: precompile caches and package images, method invalidations, PrecompileTools and SnoopCompile, system images with PackageCompiler, and juliac/--trim static executables.
queries: package images pkgimages native code caching Julia 1.9
method invalidations SnoopCompile time to first plot

leaves.leaf: Garbage collection and runtime memory management
leaves.scope: Julia's generational mark-sweep garbage collector, parallel and concurrent GC threads, heap-size hints, finalizers and WeakRef, object allocation and pools, and GC-related runtime options.
queries: garbage collector generational mark sweep Julia

leaves.leaf: Profiling, benchmarking and performance analysis
leaves.scope: Performance tips and diagnostic tools: @time and allocation tracking, the Profile stdlib and allocation profiler, flame graphs, BenchmarkTools, @code_warntype, JET.jl and Cthulhu.

leaves.leaf: REPL, command line, editors and notebooks
leaves.scope: REPL modes and keybindings, Revise.jl workflows, julia command-line flags, startup.jl and environment variables, juliaup, the VS Code Julia extension and LanguageServer, debuggers, and Pluto and IJulia notebooks.
queries: REPL modes help shell pkg mode keybindings
julia command line options startup.jl environment variables
juliaup VS Code Julia extension Pluto IJulia

leaves.leaf: Testing, documentation and package quality tooling
leaves.scope: The Test standard library and its macros, docstring conventions and @doc, Documenter.jl site generation and deployment, DocStringExtensions, Aqua.jl and CI templates such as PkgTemplates.

leaves.leaf: Linear algebra and sparse matrices
leaves.scope: The LinearAlgebra stdlib: factorizations, structured matrix types, UniformScaling, BLAS/LAPACK bindings through libblastrampoline and OpenBLAS or MKL, and SparseArrays with SuiteSparse solvers.
queries: LinearAlgebra factorization lu qr cholesky svd

leaves.leaf: Dates, Random, I/O and other standard library utilities
leaves.scope: Smaller standard libraries and Base I/O: Dates periods and formats, Random RNGs and seeding (Xoshiro, MersenneTwister), Printf, Serialization, Sockets, TOML, Downloads, and file system and stream functions.
queries: Random Xoshiro default RNG seed MersenneTwister

leaves.leaf: DataFrames and tabular data ecosystem
leaves.scope: DataFrames.jl manipulation verbs, CSV.jl reading and writing options, the Tables.jl interface, missing-value handling, CategoricalArrays, Arrow.jl and DataFramesMeta.

leaves.leaf: Plotting and visualization packages
leaves.scope: Plots.jl and its backends, the Makie family (GLMakie, CairoMakie, WGLMakie), plot recipes, Gadfly's grammar of graphics, and terminal plotting with UnicodePlots.

leaves.leaf: SciML and differential equation solving
leaves.scope: DifferentialEquations.jl problem types and solver algorithms, stiff and non-stiff methods, callbacks and events, ModelingToolkit symbolic-acausal modeling, and the wider SciML organization's packages.

leaves.leaf: Mathematical optimization with JuMP and Optim
leaves.scope: The JuMP algebraic modeling language and its macros, MathOptInterface and solver wrappers, Convex.jl, and nonlinear and unconstrained optimizers in Optim.jl, NLopt and Optimization.jl.

leaves.leaf: Machine learning and automatic differentiation
leaves.scope: Flux.jl and Lux.jl neural-network APIs, automatic differentiation with ForwardDiff dual numbers, Zygote source-to-source reverse mode and Enzyme, and the ChainRules rule system.

leaves.leaf: Statistics and probabilistic programming
leaves.scope: Distributions.jl types and methods, StatsBase, StatsModels formulas and GLM.jl regression, MixedModels, HypothesisTests, and Bayesian inference with Turing.jl samplers.
